title: Understanding Gradient Descent
text: In gradient descent, the update rule for the parameter \( $$\theta$$ \) is given by \( \theta**{(t+1)} $$=$$ \theta**{(t)} - \alpha \frac{d}{d\theta}L(\theta**{(t)}) \). This means you adjust \( $$\theta$$ \) by moving in the direction opposite to the gradient.

title: Applying the Update Rule
text: Given \( \theta**{(t+1)} $$=$$ $$9$$ \) and \( \frac{d}{d\theta}L(\theta**{(t)}) $$=$$ $$-2$$ \) at \( $$t$$ $$=$$ $$2$$ \), use the update rule \( \theta**{(t+1)} $$=$$ \theta**{(t)} - \alpha \frac{d}{d\theta}L(\theta**{(t)}) \) to find \( \theta**{(2)} \).

title: Calculate \( \theta**{(2)} \)
text: Using the update rule \( \theta**{(t+1)} $$=$$ \theta**{(t)} - \alpha \frac{d}{d\theta}L(\theta**{(t)}) \), what is \( \theta**{(2)} \) if \( \theta**{(t+1)} $$=$$ $$9$$ \), \( \alpha $$=$$ $$1$$ \), and \( \frac{d}{d\theta}L(\theta**{(t)}) $$=$$ $$-2$$ \)?
